title: USITC Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS REST API: duty rates by HTS line)
questions: what is the general (MFN) duty rate on passenger cars, HTS 8703
which HTS lines for steel flat-rolled products are duty free under the general rate
the statutory duty rate per HTS line, to multiply by import values for a customs revenue estimate
which chapter 99 additional duties apply to an HTS subheading
which free trade agreement partners get duty-free treatment on a product

manual.how: Open each link in manual_download/INSTRUCTIONS.md in a browser and save the JSON page under the name shown, then upload it. Without the links: on https://hts.usitc.gov/ search the HTS number or keyword, or use Export (choose the range of HTS numbers and JSON or CSV) and upload the file; past editions and revisions are under 'Archive' at https://hts.usitc.gov/ (PDF and CSV per revision).

cache.why: The schedule is revised several times a month; data/ is reused only within a run.

redistribution.why: The HTS is published by the U.S. International Trade Commission, a U.S. government work in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105).

citation: U.S. International Trade Commission, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States ({dataset}), hts.usitc.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which rate: the general (MFN, column 1) rate, a free trade agreement or preference rate (special), or column 2? Default: general, with any chapter 99 additional duties named separately.

Statutory rate or the rate actually collected? Default: statutory rates from this pack; the duty actually collected on imports (calculated duty by product and country) comes from census international trade.

use_instead.question: Duties actually collected, import values and quantities by HS code and country
use_instead.why: Census international trade reports import values and calculated duty; the HTS gives the statutory rates only.

use_instead.question: Total customs duties received by the Treasury, monthly or by fiscal year
use_instead.why: The Monthly Treasury Statement reports customs duty receipts.
